Each survey answer with score, results and communication ratings. It marks promoters, passives and detractors and flags low scores nobody has followed up yet.

Add each survey answer on Client Feedback and each month of work on Monthly Scope: the overrun and its cost show when the hours go over the package.
Rate each client on Client Health for how fast they reply, how they pay and how happy they are. The score also uses surveys, goals and scope, and shows who is at risk.
Log every client who leaves on Lost Clients with the reason, and every partner who sends clients on Referral Partners with the commission owed.
Fill Team Capacity each month with the hours available and booked, then use the Capacity Planner before you say yes to a new client.
Use the 14 calculators for quotes, price per post, overruns, client profit, renewals, price rises, win rate, churn risk, setup fee, discounts and referral pay.
Print client cards and agreements from the printable sheets, choose letters and checklists by the number in the yellow cell, and tap a message link to open WhatsApp with the text ready.
Read Client Dashboard and Charts every week: fees, margin, clients at risk, late onboardings, missing access, leads to follow up and renewals due.
